translations.web: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,
translations.bsb: And the twenty-four elders who sit on their thrones before God fell on their faces and worshiped God,
translations.kjv: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,
translations.asv: And the four and twenty elders, who sit before God on their thrones, fell upon their faces and worshipped God,
